pipeline.name: ${local.prefix}-app-factory
pipeline.definition: {"Comment": "Minimal App Factory demo pipeline; CodeBuild writes outputs to DynamoDB.", "StartAt": "MarkBuilding", "TimeoutSeconds": 2400, "States": {"MarkBuilding": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem", "Parameters": {"TableName": "${aws_dynamodb_table.deployments.name}", "Key": {"pk": {"S.$": "States.Format('DEPLOY#{}', $.deployment_id)"}, "sk": {"S": "META"}}, "UpdateExpression": "SET #s = :s, updated_at = :t", "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#s": "status"}, "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":s": {"S": "building"}, ":t": {"S.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime"}}}, "ResultPath": null, "Next": "StartBuild"}, "StartBuild": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::codebuild:startBuild", "Parameters": {"ProjectName": "${module.codebuild.project_name}", "EnvironmentVariablesOverride": [{"Name": "DEPLOYMENT_ID", "Value.$": "$.deployment_id", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "TEMPLATE_ID", "Value.$": "$.template_id", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "DEPLOYMENT_NAME", "Value.$": "$.deployment_name", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "IAC_TYPE", "Value.$": "$.iac_type", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "AWS_TARGET_REGION", "Value.$": "$.aws_region", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "ARCHIVE_BUCKET", "Value.$": "$.s3_bucket", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "ARCHIVE_KEY", "Value.$": "$.s3_key", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "ACTION", "Value.$": "$.action", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "USE_CASE_ID", "Value.$": "$.parameters.USE_CASE_ID", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "FRAMEWORK", "Value.$": "$.parameters.FRAMEWORK", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "DEPLOYMENT_PATTERN", "Value.$": "$.parameters.DEPLOYMENT_PATTERN", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "SUBMISSION_ID", "Value.$": "$.parameters.SUBMISSION_ID", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "APP_FACTORY_TABLE_NAME", "Value.$": "$.parameters.APP_FACTORY_TABLE_NAME", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "ENABLE_TRACING", "Value.$": "$.parameters.ENABLE_TRACING", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "LANGFUSE_HOST", "Value.$": "$.parameters.LANGFUSE_HOST", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "LANGFUSE_SECRET_NAME", "Value.$": "$.parameters.LANGFUSE_SECRET_NAME", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "STATE_BUCKET", "Value": "${module.state.bucket_name}", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "DEPLOYMENTS_TABLE", "Value": "${aws_dynamodb_table.deployments.name}", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "APP_FACTORY_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS", "Value": "150000", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "APP_FACTORY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "Value": "900", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "APP_FACTORY_MAX_CALLS", "Value": "80", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}, {"Name": "BEDROCK_MODEL_ID", "Value": "zai.glm-4.7-flash", "Type": "PLAINTEXT"}]}, "ResultPath": "$.build", "Next": "StoreBuildId", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "MarkFailed"}]}, "StoreBuildId": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem", "Parameters": {"TableName": "${aws_dynamodb_table.deployments.name}", "Key": {"pk": {"S.$": "States.Format('DEPLOY#{}', $.deployment_id)"}, "sk": {"S": "META"}}, "UpdateExpression": "SET build_id = :b", "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":b": {"S.$": "$.build.Build.Id"}}}, "ResultPath": null, "Next": "Wait", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "MarkFailed"}]}, "Wait": {"Type": "Wait", "Seconds": 20, "Next": "CheckBuild"}, "CheckBuild": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:codebuild:batchGetBuilds", "Parameters": {"Ids.$": "States.Array($.build.Build.Id)"}, "ResultPath": "$.poll", "Next": "Evaluate", "Catch": [{"ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"], "ResultPath": "$.error", "Next": "MarkFailed"}]}, "Evaluate": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.poll.Builds[0].BuildStatus", "StringEquals": "IN_PROGRESS", "Next": "Wait"}, {"Variable": "$.poll.Builds[0].BuildStatus", "StringEquals": "SUCCEEDED", "Next": "MarkDeployed"}], "Default": "MarkFailed"}, "MarkDeployed": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem", "Parameters": {"TableName": "${aws_dynamodb_table.deployments.name}", "Key": {"pk": {"S.$": "States.Format('DEPLOY#{}', $.deployment_id)"}, "sk": {"S": "META"}}, "UpdateExpression": "SET #s = :s, updated_at = :t", "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#s": "status"}, "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":s": {"S": "deployed"}, ":t": {"S.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime"}}}, "ResultPath": null, "Next": "Succeeded"}, "MarkFailed": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:updateItem", "Parameters": {"TableName": "${aws_dynamodb_table.deployments.name}", "Key": {"pk": {"S.$": "States.Format('DEPLOY#{}', $.deployment_id)"}, "sk": {"S": "META"}}, "UpdateExpression": "SET #s = :s, updated_at = :t", "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#s": "status"}, "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":s": {"S": "failed"}, ":t": {"S.$": "$$.State.EnteredTime"}}}, "ResultPath": null, "Next": "Failed"}, "Succeeded": {"Type": "Succeed"}, "Failed": {"Type": "Fail", "Error": "AppFactoryBuildFailed", "Cause": "Inspect the CodeBuild logs for this deployment."}}}
